general_notes: In every state the ten candidates fall into the same six types: (1) the painting inside a thin dark border (idle B, joyful G, fierce D, depleted J), which is effectively the target; (2) a heavily blurred full painting (idle E, joyful A, fierce H, depleted I); (3) three dark-background cut-outs with a soft glow, practically identical to each other; (4) three light-background cut-outs, also practically identical to each other, with washed-out flames and edge artifacts (an outline on the idle head, a rust rim and a dark blob in depleted, whitish streaks on the fierce body); (5) a zoomed crop in a round vignette that cuts off the legs (idle I, joyful I, fierce E, depleted A); (6) a 3D procedural reinterpretation (idle G, joyful B, fierce G, depleted C). Within each group the scores are deliberately identical because I could not see reliable differences; any differences between the near-duplicate cut-outs would be below what I can see at this resolution. For the bordered versions I deducted a little under P3/P4 for the added frame and slightly smaller scale; if the border is considered acceptable app chrome, they would be 10 across the board. The light-background cut-outs hurt the dim, moody states (depleted, idle) more than joyful. Uncertainty: I judged the cut-out edge quality at the provided resolution only.
